$comment: Retailer registry. Boughtique has no affiliate or commercial relationship with any retailer listed here. These are public storefronts we link to for discovery purposes only.

retailers.name: Zalando
retailers.description: A broad European marketplace carrying thousands of mainstream and premium labels across womenswear, menswear and footwear.

retailers.name: Nike
retailers.description: First-party sportswear storefront with a permanently rotating sale section across footwear and apparel.

retailers.name: adidas
retailers.description: German sportswear house. The outlet section is one of the more reliable sources of genuine footwear markdowns in Europe.

retailers.name: ARKET
retailers.description: Scandinavian essentials with a durable, material-led point of view. Strong for outerwear and knitwear.

retailers.name: COS
retailers.description: Architectural minimalism at contemporary prices. A reference point for clean tailoring and volume.

retailers.name: UNIQLO
retailers.description: Japanese basics engineered for repeat wear. The best value-per-wear in the mainstream market.

retailers.name: Mytheresa
retailers.description: Munich-based luxury retailer with a tightly edited designer buy and a serious seasonal sale.

retailers.name: Farfetch
retailers.description: Aggregates boutiques worldwide, which makes it the widest — and most uneven — luxury price surface in Europe.
